narrative.overview: Hopper uses the visual language of a service manual drawn by the team that built the machine. The system is flat, precise, information-rich, and platform-aware without making one host its identity.
keyCharacteristics: Saturated navy working field with bone and cyan drafting ink.
Vermilion reserved for actions, sequence numbers, and registration marks.
Condensed type, square controls, thin rules, and explicit operational labels.
Sectional product proof instead of detached application screenshots.

rules.name: The Signal Discipline Rule
rules.body: Vermilion marks action or sequence; it never becomes general decoration.

rules.name: The Compression Rule
rules.body: Display type may be tightly led and horizontally assertive; body copy must retain comfortable line height and readable measure.

rules.name: The Flat Instrument Rule
rules.body: Interface surfaces remain flat; illustration supplies material depth.

dos: Do organize capabilities as procedures, ledgers, matrices, and sectional diagrams.
Do reserve vermilion for actions and sequence.
Do keep current platform facts separate from the platform-neutral Hopper Engine story.
Do provide normal-flow mobile layouts and reduced-motion behavior.
donts: Don't introduce rounded card grids, soft drop shadows, or generic gradient heroes.
Don't place a detached product screenshot beside vague marketing copy.
Don't use vermilion for long text or low-contrast decorative fills.
